title: Sardine herb couscous
summary: Sardine herb couscous is a middle eastern dinner built around sardines in spring water and couscous, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook sardines in spring water for Sardine herb couscous in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm fresh flat-leaf parsley alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss couscous with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Sardine herb couscous straight away. Taste Sardine herb couscous before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the couscous, simmered in salted water until tender.
